description: Source code for the ENC424J600 Ethernet controller driver using SPI interface in Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, and data transmission/reception functions.

methods.name: enc424j600_write_sbc
methods.description: Write a command to the ENC424J600 via SPI.

methods.name: enc424j600_write_sfru
methods.description: Write a 16-bit value to a register in ENC424J600.

methods.name: enc424j600_read_sfru
methods.description: Read a 16-bit register value from ENC424J600.

methods.name: enc424j600_modify_sfru
methods.description: Modify a register in ENC424J600 with an opcode.

methods.name: enc424j600_write_phy
methods.description: Write to PHY register of ENC424J600.

methods.name: enc424j600_read_phy
methods.description: Read from PHY register of ENC424J600.

methods.name: enc424j600_write_mem
methods.description: Write data to ENC424J600 memory via SPI.

methods.name: enc424j600_read_mem
methods.description: Read data from ENC424J600 memory via SPI.

methods.name: enc424j600_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback for ENC424J600.

methods.name: enc424j600_init_filters
methods.description: Initialize packet filters.

methods.name: enc424j600_init_phy
methods.description: Initialize PHY settings.

methods.name: enc424j600_setup_mac
methods.description: Configure MAC settings based on link status.

methods.name: enc424j600_tx
methods.description: Transmit a network packet.

methods.name: enc424j600_rx
methods.description: Receive a network packet.

methods.name: enc424j600_rx_thread
methods.description: Thread handling incoming packets and link status.

methods.name: enc424j600_get_config
methods.description: Get current link or duplex configuration.

methods.name: enc424j600_get_capabilities
methods.description: Return hardware capabilities.

methods.name: enc424j600_iface_init
methods.description: Initialize network interface.

methods.name: enc424j600_start_device
methods.description: Start or resume the device operation.

methods.name: enc424j600_stop_device
methods.description: Stop or suspend the device operation.

methods.name: enc424j600_init
methods.description: Initialize ENC424J600 device and driver.
